ideas.pitch: A localized digital twin for Indian Type 2 diabetes patients that combines EHR profiles with simulated real-time continuous glucose monitor (CGM) streams to forecast glycemic excursions hours before they happen.
ideas.problem_statement: Build a proof-of-concept Digital Twin Model focused on predicting a specific, localized health outcome for a chronic condition prevalent in India (Type 2 Diabetes).
ideas.title: GlycoTwin: Type 2 Diabetes Glucose Spike & Lifestyle Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the core challenge theme by addressing Type 2 Diabetes in India, featuring a live-updating simulation dashboard and clinical explainability using SHAP values modeled after winning readmission architectures.

ideas.pitch: A localized cardiovascular digital twin that simulates coronary plaque progression using patient lipid profiles, wearable heart-rate variability, and localized dietary patterns.
ideas.problem_statement: Build a proof-of-concept Digital Twin Model focused on predicting a specific, localized health outcome for a chronic condition prevalent in India (Cardiovascular risk).
ideas.title: CardioVeda: Ayurvedic-Integrated Cardiovascular Risk Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on cardiovascular risk—a leading health crisis in urban India—and presents a working dashboard with clear predictive simulations that judges can interact with live.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed blood pressure fluctuation digital twin that ingests ambulatory BP monitor logs and personal EHRs to simulate morning surge events and stroke risks.
ideas.problem_statement: Build a proof-of-concept Digital Twin Model focused on predicting a specific, localized health outcome for a chronic condition prevalent in India (Hypertension).
ideas.title: HyperGuard: Hypertension & Salt-Sensitivity Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses hypertension with a heavy emphasis on hard engineering and local physiological telemetry, mirroring the architecture of award-winning biomedical IoT systems.

ideas.pitch: A specialized virtual physiological twin for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) predicting maternal-fetal metabolic stress responses based on regional dietary input and clinical biomarkers.
ideas.problem_statement: Build a proof-of-concept Digital Twin Model focused on predicting a specific, localized health outcome for a chronic condition prevalent in India (Type 2 Diabetes / Metabolic Disorders).
ideas.title: GestationalTwin: Pregnancy Metabolic Risk Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles an under-represented maternal health angle within Indian chronic disease frameworks, delivering high social impact and a clean predictive workflow.

ideas.pitch: A localized respiratory digital twin that correlates personal peak-flow meter readings and EHR history with hyper-local particulate matter data to simulate acute asthma exacerbation risks.
ideas.problem_statement: Build a proof-of-concept Digital Twin Model focused on predicting a specific, localized health outcome for a chronic condition prevalent in India (Cardiovascular and Respiratory risk).
ideas.title: RespiTwin: Urban Air Pollution Asthma Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly ties chronic respiratory conditions to major Indian urban challenges (air pollution), offering tangible preventative utility that healthcare judges prioritize.
